question: The electrostatic potential at a point in an electric field is defined as the work done by an external force in bringing a unit positive charge from infinity to that point. This definition is valid under which specific condition?

options.A: The charge is moved with constant acceleration.
options.B: The charge is moved without acceleration (infinitesimally slowly).
options.C: The charge is moved along the shortest path.
options.D: The charge is moved only along the field lines.
